detail.longDescription: 50 workloads. 2,847 CVEs. 285 that need fixing. Here's how bifrost gets there in 50 seconds. → Learn: every build of every workload – files, capabilities, syscalls → Prioritise: every CVE gets a verdict – never loaded, mitigated by the profile, or reachable → Protect: a tailored runtime profile per build. bifrost produces, the kernel enforces hardened before the patch. https://www. youtube.com/watch?v=MLD48O-IkG4 # Kubernetes # RuntimeSecurity # InfoSec # CVE
